lines.t: who know they're broken inside seek out the healer to turn the tide but the proud of heart
they walk their own way calling themselves whole while they go astray sitting in shadows of their
own design blinded by comfort they claim their shine seek out the position don't be afraid
Let the healing be made, those who rest in darkness, can see the light, only the humble, will be made right.
They rest on laurels built high and tall But every fortress of flesh must fall
Trusting in thoughts they've made their throne Forgetting the grace they could've known
The light is near, but they turn away Keeping truth at arm's length day by day
Oh, when you know you're sick, you find repair
Mercy awaits for those who care
But those self-made in their own esteem
Miss out the love beyond the dream
Only those who know their sin will see
The door wide open to liberty
